text: We represent the world. Come on. We represent the world beautifully. Yeah. We represent ghetto music. As a teen, that's when I first started writing my own jams. Recording over dirty concept tapes like dance. Picking over other cat posters. No instrumental takes. Moms, they filled with curses. Acting like a mental case. Snapping and wisecracking. Clever punch lines. Faking like I was packing. Those were fun times. But that was kid shit. I grew out of it. No need for swelling. Nowadays, you can tell the truth from the storytelling.
